releaseTitle: ATalk v3.14.2 — Real-Time Background Notification Delivery & Message/Call Subdivision Controls
releaseNotes:
• 01 Instant Background Notification Delivery: Enabled persistent background push synchronization by default and eliminated burst notifications on opening Notes. Notifications now arrive in real-time (<50ms) the moment someone sends a message or calls, even while your phone is locked or screen is off.
• 02 Message & Call Notification Subdivisions: Subdivided Notification Settings into dedicated 'Message Alerts' and 'Call Alerts' sections, providing complete granular control over message tones, vibrations, call ringtones (Gentle Chime, Phone Ringtone, Cyber Melody, Classic Bell, Silent), call vibration cadences (Continuous, Heartbeat, Double pulse, Off), and missed call alerts.
• 03 Automatic Boot & Update Resumption: Added a lightweight system BootReceiver so background message and call alerts start automatically when your phone reboots or the app updates, without needing to open the app first.
• 04 Screen Wake-up on Incoming Calls: Incoming calls now immediately wake up your phone's screen and display a full-screen high-priority call banner so you never miss a call.
• 05 Plain Everyday Language: Continued plain-language refinement across all settings cards so every feature, toggle, and disguise mode is clear, simple, and self-explanatory.
